text:
maria: Quick q — we're retiring tenant-scoped SIEM snapshot TTLs next month. Who should own rotating the CMK used for snapshot key-wrap, and what's the plan for short-lived analyst views so we don't widen blast radius?

sam: I can take rotation ownership but need clarity on procedure + who gets the unwap role.

alex: For minimal blast radius we should: 1) issue ephemeral decrypt tokens scoped to snapshot IDs, 2) rotate CMK monthly, 3) have a JIT approval ticket for analyst unwrapping.

maria: agree. can we keep the approval window to 1 hour and auto-revoke?

jamie: yes — we have an existing proxy that issues 1h ephemeral creds. We need two things: update the KMS policy to deny long-term decrypt and add an RBAC check in the proxy.

sec-bot: deploy-notification: kms/policy-update branch created by jamie at 1718760200.

sam: jamie can you paste the policy diff? want to review deny statements for decrypt outside proxy.

jamie: snippet: ```json
{
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Deny", "Action": "kms:Decrypt", "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"StringNotEquals": {"kms:ViaProxy": "siem-proxy"}} }
  ]
}
```

alex: Nice. Also add a tag requirement: only snapshots with tag `siem:short_lived=true` can be unwrapped via proxy. That helps audits.

maria: RBAC: create role `siem_analyst_jit` with MFA + ticket approval, scoped to decrypt-ephemeral. sam do you want to own the role onboarding checklist?

sam: I’ll own onboarding. I’ll draft the checklist and runbook, include sample ticket template, escalation steps, and the auto-revoke cron job.

oncall: FYI — we should also add an incident fastpath: if there's an ongoing IR we can extend a single unwrap for 4 hours via senior sec approval. log everything.

maria: agreed — add that as exception in runbook.

sam: timeline — I'll open a PR today for the role + ticket template, jamie will open KMS policy PR, alex will add tag validation to the proxy. target: deploy to staging by Friday.

maria: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sec-bot: pr-merge-checklist: waiting for 2 approvals.

alex: will review the PR this afternoon.

jamie: merged kms policy to staging at 1718760450, still waiting on role PR.

maria: follow up tomorrow morning with the runbook link and ticket template. closing this thread once runbook is in the docs repo.
